chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is the right course of action now?

options.text: I stop and wait ahead of the constricted point until the oncoming car has passed through
I pass through the constricted point by carefully driving between the oncoming car and the construction site barrier
I signal to the driver of the oncoming car that he should drive closer to the edge of the roadway

correct_answers.text: I stop and wait ahead of the constricted point until the oncoming car has passed through

comment: The bottleneck is in your lane. Therefore, you must stop before the bottleneck and wait until the oncoming car has passed.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is the right course of action here?

options.text: I queue behind the vehicles already waiting on the right
I continue driving at a reduced speed

comment: The distance to the bicycle is not enough. Stop and wait until the biker has passed the bottleneck. This is the only way to be sure that you do not endanger the biker.
